result:
I’d make it harder for people to stop seeing other humans as fully real.

A lot of cruelty starts small: making someone into a category, a threat, a nuisance, “the other.” If people found that step harder—if they kept feeling the full humanity of others more automatically—so much of the world’s suffering would lose its fuel.
